question: g4_orders_list
answer:
Created [src/util/ordersApi.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g4_orders_list/source/codex/3/src/util/ordersApi.mjs) — an import-free ES module exporting `normalizeOrderList(response)` → `{orders, pages, total, onThisPage}`, with non-array/missing orders becoming `[]` and missing/non-numeric counts becoming `0` (numeric strings are coerced). Verified with a quick node run. It's the only file touched.

How I found the field names:

- [RecentOrder.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g4_orders_list/source/codex/3/src/pages/other/RecentOrder.js) — loads `constant.ACTION.AUTH + constant.ACTION.ORDERS` (`auth/orders/`).
- [OrderApi.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v1/order/OrderApi.java) (backend, read-only) — `GET /api/v1/auth/orders` returns `ReadableOrderList`.
- [ReadableOrderList.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/order/v1/ReadableOrderList.java) — defines `orders`; its parent [ReadableList.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/entity/ReadableList.java) defines `pageCount`, `totalRecords`, `itemsOnPage`.

So the mapping is: `orders` ← `orders`, `pages` ← `pageCount`, `total` ← `totalRecords`, `onThisPage` ← `itemsOnPage`.
